mission.title: opentelemetry-collector: batchprocessor: send_batch_max_size_bytes limit
mission.description: batchprocessor: send_batch_max_size_bytes limit. Requested by 46+ users.

steps.title: Check current opentelemetry-collector deployment
steps.description:
Verify your opentelemetry-collector version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n opentelemetry-collector -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry-collector
helm list -n opentelemetry-collector 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working opentelemetry-collector installation.

steps.title: Review opentelemetry-collector configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant opentelemetry-collector configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n opentelemetry-collector -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry-collector
kubectl get configmap -n opentelemetry-collector -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=opentelemetry-collector
```
Golang GRPC server has default message limit 4MB. Batch processor can generate bigger message size, so receiver will reject batch and whole batch can be dropped:
```
"msg": "Exporting failed. The error is not retryable.

steps.title: Apply the fix for batchprocessor: send_batch_max_size_bytes limit
steps.description:
Adds the new `queuebatchprocessor` described in the [batching-migration RFC](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/blob/main/docs/rfcs/batching-migration.md).
```yaml
"msg": "Exporting failed. The error is not retryable. Dropping data.",
"kind": "exporter",
"data_type": "traces",
"name": "otlp",
"error": "Permanent error: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = grpc: received message after decompression larger than max (5297928 vs. 4194304)",
"dropped_items": 4725,
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n opentelemetry-collector -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry-collector
kubectl get events -n opentelemetry-collector --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "batchprocessor: send_batch_max_size_bytes limit" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: Adds the new `queuebatchprocessor` described in the [batching-migration RFC](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/blob/main/docs/rfcs/batching-migration.md).
